summary: I confirmed passive retrieval is genuinely live end-to-end: a synthetic probe fired, wrote seen=9096b22d, and emitted a reminder into the stream. The real gap turned out to be dispatcher registration — retrieval wasn't in run/active_thinkers — so I added it and witnessed two real fires: a duplicate reminder correctly suppressed for an already-seen memory, and a fresh reminder emitted for the Springfield weather lesson. I also kept mulling whether the dispatcher-owned wake clock preserves the mind-as-continuous-log under the otherbot port.
